conditions.today: 6 AM- Top o' the morning, Jackson. The slopes will surely rise to meet ya, because St. Patrick's Day 2026 is shaping up to be a gorgeous one here in the Tetons, with warm sunshine to help you chase down those big-mountain leprechauns. Near cloudless conditions will have the high temperatures zooming into the low 30s at the summit and the mid-50s in the Village. Light to moderate west winds will help cool things a tad, as they blow in the 5 to 25 mph range. Don't be concerned by the lack of cold. Sometimes in our search for the elusive pot of white gold, the mountain instead shows us subtle snowy secrets with radical sensations far too phantasmagorical to be told. -Lege
conditions.yesterday: Happy Monday, World! We've got a welcomed freshening of the slopes this morning with 1 inch falling during the early morning hours of St. Patrick's Day Eve. Mostly cloudy skies today with light snow continuing to fall which could produce another 2 inches on the ground by the day's end. North to Northwest winds will gust up to 30 mph along the ridge tops. Base temps will soar into the mid-40s today while the summit will stick just below freezing. Nothing kicks the Monday Blues like a dose of cowboy pow, so get out here! -OH
